The '''Foundation of Freedom''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] that was allegedly stolen from the government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]] by its separatist [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Meriso]], sparking conflict between the two that only ended when the blaster was found and returned during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|First Shot of Freedom}}</ref>
